references.title: Azure Cosmos DB Database Accounts GET REST API
Azure Cosmos DB online backup and on-demand restore

steps: Confirm the exact account, backup mode and owner-approved minimum retention; check whether the proposed mode or tier change is supported and what it will cost.
For a measured shortfall, have the account owner change the periodic retention hours or select an approved continuous tier through the owned Azure configuration or IaC after migration-impact review.

Re-read the account backup policy and separately test an approved restore workflow; if the migration disrupts recovery or cost expectations, follow the owner's reviewed rollback path rather than assuming mode changes are reversible.
azure_cosmos_account_10_5_1_5_2029065.summary: Align the Cosmos DB account's declared backup retention with its approved minimum.
